title: 第101章 你要找的萧策，就是朕！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 听到唐逸的话，原本喧嚣的鹿鸣湖，瞬间陷入死寂。　　落针可闻。　　所有人都被唐逸的话给震住了。　　颜霜玉和姜云那已经瞪大双眼，唐画和刘州脸上的得意都僵住了，刘温正在喝茶，一口茶已经喷了出去……　　赵轲等一群大臣，也都脸色怪异和嘲弄，你还真敢认啊！　　唐敬脸色铁青，愤怒的眉心直跳，这混蛋在家疯就算了，竟然还敢在这种场合疯。　　宇文封猛地站了起来，浑身杀意弥漫，那个该死的小诗仙，可给他们北狄的大计造成了很大的损失。　　唐逸要真是小诗仙，那他死定了。　　龙斩眼睛微微眯起，怎么个意思？冒牌货成真的了？　　孙霸已经攥紧拳头，激动得呼吸急促，小诗仙在暗榜可值五万两，要是唐逸和小诗仙是同一个人，宰了唐逸，嘿，净赚五万五！　　“呵，小诗仙？你也配？！”　　太子刚刚悄悄抵达，刚坐下去，听到唐逸的话，嘴角便泛起浓浓的嘲讽。　　唐逸的情况，他早就调查得清清楚楚明明白白，谁都可能是小诗仙，唯独唐逸不可能，因为这几年，他就在唐家刷马桶！　　远处阁楼中，孔诗岚和萧澜同样呆住了。　　听到了什么？　　唐逸说他是小诗仙？　　她们辛辛苦苦找了几天，没有找到半点踪迹的小诗仙，是唐逸？　　“岚……岚姐，他说的……是真的吗？”　　萧澜的声音都带着颤音了，这可不能是真的啊！本宫可不想本宫孩子他爹，变成了姐夫了。　　“应该……不，绝对不是真的。”孔诗岚抿了抿唇，随即坚定说道。　　她查过唐逸，知道唐逸的情况，他怎么可能是小诗仙？　　可是，他不是小诗仙……那他怎么这么确定，小诗仙会来参加诗会？　　一时之间，孔诗岚也有些心乱如麻。　　“你是小诗仙？！”　　此时，最震惊的莫过于萧棣了。　　他几乎当场蹦了起来，声音都有些破音了。　　他也不知道唐逸就是小诗仙，这家伙完全没说过啊！　　萧棣的话，让所有人都回了神。　　当时看向唐逸的目光，顿时更加的嘲讽和戏谑了。　　这段时间他们都在追小诗仙的下落，因此非常清楚，唐逸就是皇帝给小诗仙找的替身。　　现在，替身竟然想要转正？！　　“哈哈，原来唐四少就是小诗仙了，好厉害！”　　“唐四少，你写的《满江红》那是慷慨激昂，但你看起来好像很废啊！”　　“唐逸，你字认全了吗？你就敢吹！”　　“……”　　现场顿时喧嚣起来，嘲讽笑声回荡全场。　　见到这一幕，唐逸不由摇了摇头，和你们说句实话，怎么就不相信呢？　　而唐音见到哥哥被羞辱，再也忍不住，直接跑了出来，站在唐逸的身侧。　　哥哥那么厉害，才不是废物呢。　　你们才是废物，全家都是废物！　　“我哥哥没吹牛，我哥哥就是小诗仙！”　　唐音气鼓鼓，双手撑着腰愤怒得小脸涨红：“我哥哥给萧策叔叔写了《满江红》，还给将军爷爷和福王爷爷各写了一首。”　　“对了，还有我杜姐姐，我哥哥也给杜姐姐写了《美人诗》！”　　然而，看着唐音气鼓鼓的样子，现场的笑声顿时更浓了。　　“这小子，还真把自己当回事了，真以为我们不知道他是陛下找的替身呢？”　　刘温盯着唐逸，摇了摇头道：“唐侍郎，你这儿子是当假的当久了，入戏太深了？”　　唐敬没有说话，只是脸色冰冷无比，混账东西，你还真敢说，唐家的脸，都被你丢光了！　　“哈哈哈……小诗仙？你是小诗仙？”　　刘州指着唐逸，笑得都快直不起腰了：“你要是小诗仙，本少爷直接将整张桌子吃下去。”　　“还给萧策写了《满江红》？萧策是谁啊？”　　“你让他站出来，让他站到少爷我面前，让他证明你是小诗仙啊，哈哈……”　　听到这话，刘温顿时目瞪口呆。　　混账东西，你胡说什么？这种话你也敢说？　　你知道萧策是谁吗？！　　他猛地站了起来，想要阻止刘州胡说八道。　　然而，这时一道冰冷的声音，已经在过道传来。　　“要是没出现意外的话，你所说的萧策，应该就是朕！”　　听到这声音，所有人齐齐循声望去。　　只见穿着便装手持折扇的炎文帝，正在孔老太傅的陪伴下，向着这边走了过来。　　包括唐逸。　　此时见到炎文帝，唐逸已经呆在当场。　　我特么！　　萧策是皇帝？　　他怎么就是皇帝了？　　他难道不该是朝中哪一个有权有势的王吗？　　唐逸当场就傻了，他不是没怀疑过萧棣的身份，但他自始至终都以为萧策只是某位王爷而已。　　却没想到，萧策竟是皇帝啊！　　妈的，难怪宁川和锦衣卫一处这么听话，原来这就是他们的老大啊！　　而刘州，早就吓得三魂出窍，整个人已经软绵绵地往地下跪去。　　见到炎文帝，所有人跪地行礼。　　全场站着的，就只剩下了唐逸和唐音兄妹俩。　　这就导致他们两人，看上去非常的显眼了。　　“怎么？见到朕吓到了？”　　炎文帝没有理会跪着的众人，而是看向唐逸。　　见到唐逸的震惊的样子，别说，这种感觉还挺爽。　　嘿，不枉朕瞒了这么久！　　“臣……臣参见陛下！”　　唐逸连忙躬身行礼，无语道：“陛下是皇帝，那就直接和臣直说就是了，没必要瞒着臣吧？”　　炎文帝瞥了唐逸一眼，没好气道：“别往自己脸上贴金，谁说朕瞒的是你？朕瞒的是他们！”　　唐逸听到这话，看向跪了一地的满朝文武，嘴角顿时一阵抽搐。　　他明白炎文帝的意思，他莫名其妙成了炎文帝和大臣斗争的棋子了。　　“萧叔叔。”　　唐音可不知道皇帝是什么，就知道炎文帝是疼爱他的萧叔叔。　　她当即就向着炎文帝跑了过去，抱着炎文帝的大腿仰着脑袋看他，一双大眼睛微微泛红。　　“萧叔叔，他们欺负我哥哥。”　　“他们说哥哥是废物，还说哥哥是青楼最受欢迎的人。”　　她一眨眼，眼泪簌簌而落：“萧叔叔，青楼是什么呀？”　　听到这话，原本嘚瑟的刘州，就像是被抽走了脊椎骨一般，整个人软绵绵地趴在了地上。　　吓趴下了！
content_en: After hearing Tang Yi's words, the originally noisy Luming Lake suddenly fell into dead silence.You can hear the needle drop.Everyone was shocked by Tang Yi's words.Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna's eyes widened, Tang Hua and Liu Zhou's faces froze with pride, Liu Wen was drinking tea, and a mouthful of tea had spit out... Zhao Ke and a group of ministers also had weird and mocking expressions on their faces, how dare you recognize them!Tang Jing's face was livid, and his eyebrows were beating with anger. Even if this bastard was crazy at home, he still dared to be crazy in such a situation.Yu Wenfeng stood up suddenly, his whole body filled with murderous intent. That damn little poetry fairy had caused great losses to their Beidi plan.If Tang Yi was really a little poetry fairy, he would be dead.Long Zhan narrowed his eyes slightly, what do you mean?Did the counterfeit become real?Sun Ba had already clenched his fists and was breathing rapidly with excitement. Xiao Shixian was worth fifty thousand taels on the secret list. If Tang Yi and Xiao Shixian were the same person and killed Tang Yi, hey, a net profit of fifty thousand taels!"Ha, little Shixian? Are you worthy?!" The prince had just arrived quietly and sat down, when he heard Tang Yi's words, a deep sarcasm emerged from the corner of his mouth.He had already investigated Tang Yi's situation clearly and clearly. Anyone could be a Poet Fairy, but Tang Yi couldn't be so, because in the past few years, he had been cleaning toilets in the Tang family's house!In the distant attic, Kong Shilan and Xiao Lan were also stunned.What did you hear?Tang Yi said he was a little poetry fairy?They searched hard for several days but could not find any trace of the little Shixian. Is it Tang Yi?"Lan...Sister Lan, is what he said...true?" Xiao Lan's voice was trembling. This can't be true!I don’t want my child’s father to become my brother-in-law."It should be... no, it's definitely not true." Kong Shilan pursed her lips and then said firmly.She checked Tang Yi and knew about Tang Yi's situation. How could he be the Little Poet Fairy?But, he is not the Little Poet Fairy... Then how can he be so sure that the Little Poet Fairy will come to the poetry meeting?For a moment, Kong Shilan was also a little confused."Are you the little poetry fairy?!" At this time, the most shocked person was Xiao Di.He almost jumped up on the spot, his voice even breaking.He didn’t know that Tang Yi was the Little Poet Fairy. This guy never mentioned it at all!Xiao Di's words brought everyone back to their senses.The look that looked at Tang Yi at that time became even more mocking and joking.During this period of time, they had been chasing the whereabouts of Xiao Shixian, so they knew very well that Tang Yi was the substitute that the emperor had found for Xiao Shixian.Now, the substitute actually wants to become a full-time employee?!"Haha, it turns out that Fourth Young Master Tang is a little poetry fairy, so awesome!" "Four Young Master Tang, your writing of "Man Jiang Hong" is impassioned, but you look like a loser!" "Tang Yi, do you know all the words? You dare to brag!" "..." The scene suddenly became noisy, and the mocking laughter echoed throughout the audience.Seeing this scene, Tang Yi couldn't help but shook his head. To be honest with you, why don't you believe it?When Tang Yin saw her brother being humiliated, she couldn't bear it anymore and ran out directly and stood beside Tang Yi.Brother is so powerful, he is not a waste.You are the trash, and the whole family is trash!"My brother is not bragging, my brother is a little poetry fairy!" Tang Yin was angry, holding his hands on his waist and his little face turned red with anger: "My brother wrote "Man Jiang Hong" for Uncle Xiao Ce, and also wrote one for Grandpa General and Grandpa Fu Wang." "By the way, there is also my sister Du, and my brother also wrote "Beauty Poetry" for Sister Du!" However, seeing Tang Yin's angry look, the laughter at the scene suddenly became stronger."This boy really takes himself seriously. Do you really think we don't know that he is His Majesty's substitute?" Liu Wen stared at Tang Yi, shook his head and said, "Tang Shilang, has your son been a fake for a long time and got too involved in the drama?" Tang Jing didn't say anything, but his face was extremely cold. You bastard, you really dare to say that the Tang family's face has been completely embarrassed by you!"Hahaha... Little Poet Fairy? Are you a Little Poet Fairy?" Liu Zhou pointed at Tang Yi, laughing so hard that he almost couldn't stand up: "If you were a Little Poet Fairy, I would eat the whole table." "Give it back to Xiao.Ce wrote "Man Jiang Hong"?"Who is Xiao Ce?""Let him stand up, let him stand in front of me, the young master, let him prove that you are a little poetry fairy, haha..." Hearing this, Liu Wen was stunned.Bastard, what are you talking about?Do you dare to say such a thing?Do you know who Xiao Ce is?!He stood up suddenly, trying to stop Liu Zhou from talking nonsense.However, at this moment, a cold voice came from the corridor."If nothing unexpected happens, the Xiao Ce you are talking about should be me!" Upon hearing this voice, everyone followed the sound.Emperor Yanwen, wearing casual clothes and holding a folding fan, was seen walking towards this side, accompanied by Mrs. Kong.Including Tang Yi.When he saw Emperor Yanwen at this time, Tang Yi was already on the spot.What the hell!Xiao Ce is the emperor?Why is he the emperor?Shouldn't he be one of the most powerful kings in the court?Tang Yi was stunned on the spot. He had doubted Xiao Di's identity, but he thought Xiao Ce was just a certain prince from beginning to end.But I didn’t expect that Xiao Ce was actually the emperor!Damn it, no wonder Ning Chuan and Jin Yiwei are so obedient, it turns out this is their boss!Liu Zhou, on the other hand, was so frightened that his three souls came out of his body, and he knelt down limply.Seeing Emperor Yanwen, everyone knelt down and saluted.The only ones standing in the audience were brother and sister Tang Yi and Tang Yin.This made the two of them look very conspicuous."What? Are you scared when you see me?" Emperor Yanwen ignored the kneeling people and looked at Tang Yi.Seeing Tang Yi's shocked look, let alone, it felt quite good.Hey, it’s not in vain that I kept it secret for so long!"I...I see your Majesty!" Tang Yi quickly bowed and saluted, and said speechlessly: "Your Majesty is the emperor, so just tell me directly. There is no need to hide it from me, right?" Emperor Yan Wen glanced at Tang Yi and said angrily: "Don't put gold on your face, who said I was hiding it from you? I was hiding it from them!" When Tang Yi heard this, he looked at kneeling on the ground.
title_en: Chapter 101 The Xiao Ce you are looking for is me!
